 LIFESTYLE Personal Finance Are you getting your Social Security Payment this Wednesday, November 11? This is the list for the next payment
 Veterans Day changes the usual November payment calendar, meaning some retirees and disability beneficiaries will receive their money a day earlier than expected
 Social Security Administration 
 EUAN BURNS (SAM)
 Editor Editor Updated 09/11/2026

 Millions of Americans are preparing for their next Social Security payment, but the November calendar contains an important change that beneficiaries should be aware of.
 Although Wednesday, November 11, would normally be the second-Wednesday payment date, the Social Security Administration (SSA) has moved the deposit forward because it coincides with Veterans Day.
 Social Security: When is COLA announced, how is it determined and how much can people expect? M.C. As a result, eligible recipients will not have to wait until Wednesday to receive their money. Instead, the next group of retirement, survivor and Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) beneficiaries is scheduled to receive its November payment on Tuesday, November 10.
 The adjustment affects people whose birthdays fall between the first and 10th of any month and who receive benefits under the standard Wednesday payment system.
 It does not mean they are receiving an additional check or a larger benefit. The money is simply being delivered one day earlier because of the federal holiday.
 The change is particularly important for households that rely on Social Security to cover recurring expenses such as rent, groceries, utilities and medical costs.
 Knowing the correct deposit date can help beneficiaries avoid planning around a payment that will not arrive on the day they originally expected. The SSA's official 2026 calendar confirms the revised November schedule.
 Social Security payment dates for November 2026
 The SSA generally distributes retirement, survivor and disability benefits across three Wednesdays each month. The date assigned to an individual depends on the birth date of the person whose earnings record is used to claim the benefit.
 For November, the schedule has been adjusted because Veterans Day falls on the second Wednesday. The remaining payment dates are:
 - Tuesday, November 10: Beneficiaries born between the 1st and 10th.
 - Wednesday, November 18: Beneficiaries born between the 11th and 20th.
 - Wednesday, November 25: Beneficiaries born between the 21st and 31st.
 People who began receiving Social Security before May 1997 generally follow a different schedule. Their November payment was scheduled for Tuesday, November 3, rather than one of the Wednesday dates.
 The same third-of-the-month payment arrangement generally applies to people who receive both Social Security and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) , although their SSI payment follows its own calendar.
 Why is the November 11 payment arriving early?
 Veterans Day is a federal holiday observed annually on November 11 to recognize people who have served in the United States Armed Forces.
 In 2026, it falls on a Wednesday, which would ordinarily be the scheduled payment date for beneficiaries born between the first and 10th.
 Federal holidays can affect the SSA's payment timetable. When a scheduled payment date falls on a holiday or weekend, the agency generally moves the deposit to the preceding business day.
 That is why the November payment is arriving on Tuesday, November 10. The adjustment affects the timing rather than the value of the benefit, so recipients should not expect an extra payment because of the change.
 The agency's offices will also be closed on Veterans Day, meaning anyone who needs assistance should take the holiday into account when planning to contact Social Security.
 What about Supplemental Security Income recipients?
 SSI follows a separate payment timetable from standard Social Security retirement and disability benefits. Payments are normally issued on the first day of each month, but the date is moved forward when the first falls on a weekend or federal holiday.
 November 1, 2026, fell on a Sunday. Consequently, SSI recipients received their November payment early, on Friday, October 30.
 The next scheduled SSI deposit is December 1, which covers that month's benefit. Another calendar adjustment will occur at the end of December: the January 2027 SSI payment is scheduled for Thursday, December 31, because January 1 is a federal holiday.
 What should you do if your payment does not arrive?
 Beneficiaries who do not see their money on the expected date should first check their bank account and confirm that their payment information is correct. A delay does not necessarily mean that their eligibility has changed or that their benefits have been suspended.
 The SSA advises recipients to allow three additional mailing days after the expected payment date before contacting the agency about a missing check. People can also review their benefit information through their personal my Social Security account.
 For those receiving direct deposits, checking with their financial institution may help establish whether the payment has been received but not yet appeared in the account.
 The most important date for the next group is therefore November 10, not November 11. Beneficiaries born between the 1st and 10th should plan around Tuesday's deposit, while the remaining Wednesday payment groups will receive their money on November 18 and November 25.
